test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 20 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A man has invested ₹65,000 at a rate of 7(1)/(2)\% per annum simple interest for 6 years. Find the amount that he will receive after 6 years.
solution:
**Given:**

Principal (P) = ₹65,000

Rate of interest (R) = 7¹⁄₂% per annum = 7.5%

Time (T) = 6 years

**Formula Used:**

Simple Interest (SI) = (P × R × T) / 100

Amount (A) = Principal + Simple Interest

**Calculation:**

Simple Interest:

SI = (65,000 × 7.5 × 6) / 100

⇒ SI = (65,000 × 45) / 100

⇒ SI = 29,250

Amount:

A = Principal + Simple Interest

⇒ A = 65,000 + 29,250

⇒ A = 94,250

**The amount that he will receive after 6 years is ₹94,250.**
